title: Procyanidin C1 from hawthorn modulates metabolic-inflammatory axis to combat vascular senescence in atherosclerosis.
authors: Li, Min; Si, Jia-Yao; Xie, Peng-Fei; Feng, Zhen-Jie; Li, Sheng-Jie; Zhou, Feng; Li, Jian-Mei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山楂来源原花青素C1通过HSP90/TLR2/NF-κB通路抗动脉粥样硬化与血管衰老，属纯药理学与代谢研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The global aging crisis has increased the risk of atherosclerosis (AS), positioning vascular senescence as a critical therapeutic target. Procyanidin C1 (PCC1), a bioactive polyphenol from hawthorn, demonstrates dual senolytic and longevity-enhancing effects. This study explored the regulatory role and mechanisms of PCC1 in AS using an ApoE(-/-) mouse model fed a high-fat diet (HFD) and a D-galactose (D-Gal)-induced cellular senescence model. Hawthorn oligomeric proanthocyanidins (HOPCs), as well as PCC1, showed potent anti-atherosclerotic and anti-aging effects by improving serum lipid metabolism and reducing aortic root plaque, vascular senescence markers and inflammatory adhesion molecules. Metabolomic analysis demonstrated that PCC1 significantly suppresses key enzymes in arachidonic acid (AA) metabolism, thereby decreasing downstream pro-inflammatory mediators. Target identification studies, including drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assay, liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and molecular docking, identified heat shock protein 90 (HSP90) as a direct target of PCC1, leading to inhibition of its downstream signaling. In vitro, PCC1 selectively cleared senescent cells, suppressed the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), enhanced endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) phosphorylation, and inhibited the toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2)/nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) pathway, demonstrating multimodal anti-aging and anti-inflammatory effects. Together, these findings indicate that PCC1 mitigates atherosclerosis by targeting both metabolic and inflammatory pathways through senescent cell clearance and HSP90-mediated blockade of the TLR2/NF-kappaB signaling axis. This dual mechanism highlights PCC1 as a promising vasoprotective agent and supports the potential application of hawthorn extracts in functional foods aimed at preventing aging-related cardiovascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 全球老龄化危机加剧了动脉粥样硬化（atherosclerosis, AS）的风险，使血管衰老成为关键的治疗靶点。原花青素C1（Procyanidin C1, PCC1）是从山楂中提取的一种生物活性多酚，具有双重去衰老和延长寿命的作用。本研究利用高脂饮食（high-fat diet, HFD）喂养的ApoE(-/-)小鼠模型和D-半乳糖（D-galactose, D-Gal）诱导的细胞衰老模型，探讨了PCC1在AS中的调控作用及其机制。山楂低聚原花青素（hawthorn oligomeric proanthocyanidins, HOPCs）以及PCC1通过改善血清脂质代谢、减少主动脉根部斑块、血管衰老标志物和炎症粘附分子，显示出强效的抗动脉粥样硬化和抗衰老作用。代谢组学分析表明，PCC1显著抑制花生四烯酸（arachidonic acid, AA）代谢中的关键酶，从而减少下游促炎介质。靶点鉴定研究，包括药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（drug affinity responsive target stability, DARTS）实验、液相色谱-串联质谱（liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, LC-MS/MS）、细胞热位移实验（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）和分子对接，确定热休克蛋白90（heat shock protein 90, HSP90）为PCC1的直接靶点，导致其下游信号传导受到抑制。在体外，PCC1选择性清除衰老细胞，抑制衰老相关分泌表型（senescence-associated secretory phenotype, SASP），增强内皮型一氧化氮合酶（endothelial nitric oxide synthase, eNOS）磷酸化，并抑制Toll样受体2（toll-like receptor 2, TLR2）/核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa-B, NF-kappaB）通路，展现出多模式抗衰老和抗炎作用。综合这些发现表明，PCC1通过清除衰老细胞和HSP90介导的TLR2/NF-kappaB信号轴阻断，靶向代谢和炎症通路，从而减轻动脉粥样硬化。这种双重机制凸显了PCC1作为一种有前景的血管保护剂，并支持山楂提取物在功能性食品中预防衰老相关心血管疾病的潜在应用。
